title: BlueHarbor Insurance outbound scratchpad
content: Notes to self / snapshot: BlueHarbor Insurance (regional P&C + commercial lines, midsize: ~1.2k employees, heavy broker network). Interested in using LLMs to accelerate claims triage, intake summarization, and agent-assist for complex commercial policies. Likely conservative on data residency and compliance (HIPAA-ish? they handle some PHI through health-related policies).
